title: Why Is My Coffee Maker Not Brewing?

seo.title: Why Is My Coffee Maker Not Brewing?
seo.meta_description: A coffee maker that powers on but does not brew may have a misseated reservoir, mineral buildup, a stuck valve, or a cycle blocked by settings.
seo.search_intent: Identify the likely causes of “Why Is My Coffee Maker Not Brewing,” use observable clues to choose the first checks, and know when to stop or get professional help.

excerpt: A coffee maker that powers on but does not brew may have a misseated reservoir, mineral buildup, a stuck valve, or a cycle blocked by settings. If it does not power on at all, troubleshooting starts with power and the cord rather than descaling.
content_html:
A coffee maker that powers on but does not brew may have a misseated reservoir, mineral buildup, a stuck valve, or a cycle blocked by settings. If it does not power on at all, troubleshooting starts with power and the cord rather than descaling.

Separate a power problem from a water-flow problem

If the display is dead, verify the outlet and inspect the cord without opening the base. If the machine powers and heats but does not move water, focus on the reservoir, flow path, and descaling.

Reseat the reservoir and confirm the water level

Removable reservoirs may need to press a valve when seated. Remove the tank, clean the mating area, fill within the marked limits, and reinstall it so it sits fully in place.

Descale using the manufacturer’s procedure

Mineral scale can narrow passages and slow or stop flow. Use the product and sequence recommended for the model; do not mix acids, bleach, or improvised cleaners inside the beverage path.

Abnormal noise, electrical odor, or internal leakage requires service

If the pump hums without moving water after proper descaling, a burning odor appears, or water reaches the base, unplug the machine. Do not open components containing heaters, pumps, or energized wiring.

faq.question: How can I tell whether the coffee maker has a power problem or a water-flow problem?
faq.answer: If the display is dead, verify the outlet and inspect the cord without opening the base. If the machine powers and heats but does not move water, focus on the reservoir, flow path, and descaling.

faq.question: What should I check on a removable water reservoir?
faq.answer: Removable reservoirs may need to press a valve when seated. Remove the tank, clean the mating area, fill within the marked limits, and reinstall it so it sits fully in place.

faq.question: When does a coffee maker need service instead of another descaling cycle?
faq.answer: If the pump hums without moving water after proper descaling, a burning odor appears, or water reaches the base, unplug the machine. Do not open components containing heaters, pumps, or energized wiring.
